understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to win each level by positioning all selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a `+` is occupied at the same time, within the available step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The game is played on a grid with obstacles/walls that block movement. You control one currently-selected piece at a time; actions attempt to move that selected piece, but if the destination/path is blocked (by walls, obstacles, or other pieces), the piece does not move and the step is still consumed. Clicking on a tile/piece issues a move/selection-type command in the same coordinate system as the piece positions (e.g., clicks at [9,21] and [18,21] moved the selected piece between those cells), while other clicks produced no movement when the move was illegal.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to win each level by positioning all selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a `+` is occupied at the same time, within the available step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The game is played on a grid with obstacles/walls that block movement. You control one currently-selected piece at a time; actions attempt to move that selected piece, but if the destination/path is blocked (by walls, obstacles, or other pieces), the piece does not move and the step is still consumed. Clicking on a tile/piece issues a move/selection-type command in the same coordinate system as the piece positions (e.g., clicks at [9,21] and [18,21] moved the selected piece between those cells), while other clicks produced no movement when the move was illegal.
